title: Four-language computation bank
statement: Let $f$ be a function from finite Boolean lists to finite Boolean lists. Define a function on the four-element set $\{0,1,2,3\}$ with values in languages of Boolean lists by assigning, in order, the languages for input bits, input length, the computation language for $f$ with length mode false, and the computation language for $f$ with length mode true.
hypotheses_covered: function f from Boolean lists to Boolean lists
